$comment: Delegation (O4.3.2) and meeting (O4.4.2) screen strings, with the game-week staff one-on-one (O6.6.1). Every user-facing string comes from here by id with named slots. Task ids, titles, conversation lines and reads are content keys resolved by the host's text lookup.

strings.dg.title: Delegation
strings.dg.readOnly: Your boss sets who does what. Read only.
strings.dg.noReview: no review step: approving costs nothing extra
strings.dg.record: {held} of {products} held up on game day, {replaced} redone by you
strings.dg.blocked.noQualified: Nobody on your staff can take this: it stays with you.
strings.dg.blocked.noStaff: You have no staff: you do everything.
strings.dg.totals: Your projected week: {projected} of {budget} hours ({fixed} fixed, {tasks} on these tasks). Staff save you {saved} hours.
strings.dg.over: Over your hours: something will not get done.
strings.dg.staff.row: {name}: {load} h of his own work plus {delegated} h from you, of {capacity} h
strings.dg.staff.over: over his hours: his lowest-priority work comes back incomplete
strings.dg.said: What your staff has said about how much say they want
strings.mt.title: Meetings and conversations
strings.mt.pick: Open a player from the roster or locker room to talk with him.
strings.mt.mood.unknown: How he seems: you have not had a read on him yet
strings.mt.last.none: You have not talked with him one on one yet.
strings.mt.imported: Real-roster player: talks stay on football (role and performance).
strings.mt.subject: Subject
strings.mt.stance.hand_off: hand it to his position coach
strings.mt.lieRisk: Your depth chart says otherwise: saying this is a lie risk.
strings.mt.beyond: Beyond your authority: it is recorded, but you cannot be held to it.
strings.mt.noPromise: At your rung you cannot make a promise you can be held to.
strings.mt.tracker.assistant: made for you by an assistant
strings.mt.honesty: Your word, as the room has seen it
strings.mt.honesty.row: Promises kept {kept} · broken {broken} · caught saying something untrue {caught} · contradicted in public {public}
strings.mt.staff.pick: Pick a staff member for this week's one-on-one.
strings.mt.staff.learned: What he has noticed about how you like things
strings.mt.staff.learned.none: He has not seen enough of your decisions to read your habits yet.
strings.mt.staff.suggest.none: He has nothing to raise this week.
strings.mt.staff.sheet: Calls he would put back on the sheet
strings.mt.staff.sheet.row: {call} in {box}: you have taken it out {weeks} weeks running
